ops.oldText: FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT WILL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AGGREGATE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY SUCH PARTY TO THE OTHER PARTY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) ONE MILLION DOLLARS USD ($1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 10 (CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION) OR ANY DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATION, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OR MISAPPROPRIATION OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2, AND SUCH AMOUNTS WILL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO OR COUNTING AGAINST THE FOREGOING CAP.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 waives indirect damages but sets no aggregate monetary cap for either Party, so both of us are exposed without limit; our position is a mutual cap at the greater of twelve (12) months' payments and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and PB's Article 6 and Section 14.2 payment obligations are preserved and are not treated as capped damages.
input.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap with standard uncapped carve-outs to Section 15.11, preserving PB's Article 6/14.2 payment obligations.
